about_the_game:
This Virtual Currency pack contains VC for use in MyFACTION, the collectible-card game in WWE 2K25, to purchase cards and card packs featuring your favorite WWE Superstars and Legends.

VC purchases optional. Purchased VC can only be used in WWE 2K25 and cannot be transferred.
